249575101_cb3f6032.text: PHb GABA neurons, which are defined by the coexpression of Vgat, Gad1, and Gad2, do not express parvalbumin or somatostatin, classic markers of TRN neurons (Li et al., 2020)(256823087), or nNOS, previously shown to delineate a subpopulation of dLGN interneurons (Leist et al., 2016).
